<thought>The main peak at m/z 121.0528 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 120.0455 Da. The formula that best matches this mass using only C, H, and O is C₄H₈O₄ (calculated monoisotopic mass 120.0423 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value). No other elements appear necessary.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
